backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The profile uses only rank already known after signal-date close and before next-open paper entry. It does not ask production or LLM to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY and QQQ OHLCV Close rows for market confirmation

gate3.note: No new core filter, entry source, or paper candidate filter was added. Only paper notional allocation changes.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: exp037 proved top-2 VCP breadth; rank-2 may deserve more or less notional than equal sizing.

2_history_check.exp-20260525-032: Dry-up filter lagged exp022, arguing against another hard filter and for capital allocation on the accepted top-2 set.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-037: Top-2 equal-notional passed vs exp022 by +0.8237 EV / +$11,386.36, while top-3 failed due window regressions.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same docs/backtesting.md three windows. A profile must beat exp037 aggregate EV by at least 5%, have no EV/PnL regression versus exp037 in any window, keep drawdown drift <=0.50pp versus exp037, and pass concentration guards.

hypothesis: The exp-20260525-037 top-2 VCP alpha may have a better capital allocation profile than equal $10k/$10k notional. Because rank 2 added positive EV in all three windows while top-3 added noise, a rank-2 notional scalar may improve expected value without changing entry selection.
interpretation: At least one rank-notional profile beat exp037 under the replay gate. Promote only the accepted default-off paper adapter profile with parity tests.
next_evidence_needed: If accepted, collect closed forward replacement-value rows for the profiled top-2 sleeve before any live/default trade adapter.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: An accepted profile may only update the shared default-off VCP paper adapter with parity tests. It remains observe-only and cannot create live/default orders.

why_not_other_changes: Did not retry top-3, which already failed in exp037. Did not add another hard filter after pocket-pivot, event-context, and dry-up lagged exp022. This tests capital allocation on the accepted top-2 candidate set only.
